<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 233.9632, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈232.956 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 intensity ≈24 % of the base peak) matches the presence of a single chlorine atom (⁷⁵Cl/³⁷Cl). Solving for a formula CₓH_yO_zCl that matches the neutral mass yields the best fit C₁₁H₂O₄Cl (calculated monoisotopic mass = 232.964 Da, within experimental error). Therefore the molecular formula is C11H2O4Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H2O4Cl</final_answer>
